messages.subject: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

messages.body:
Dear colleagues at Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG,

Thank you for your quote and for explaining your position.

Our demand forecast for this part has changed +11.9% (fc:350011@2026-09). Your on-time delivery over the last four quarters was 90.4% (sc:70510@2026Q3).

We have analysed the cost situation of this part carefully; the options below reflect that analysis.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 362.25 per unit, payment 90 days net, fixed price, no index clause.
Option B: EUR 358.15 per unit, payment 30 days net, fixed price, no index clause.
Option C: EUR 359.22 per unit, payment 45 days net, fixed price, no index clause.

Could you share a cost breakdown for this part - material, conversion, overhead?

We look forward to your view on these options.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We have selected your 30-day payment option, as extended terms would necessitate a higher unit price. 

Therefore, we propose a revised price of EUR 369.76 per unit, and our colleagues will address your request regarding the cost structure separately. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.

Our current offer stands at a price of €373.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. Alternatively, with standard terms, we offer a price of €369.76 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: €369.76 per unit.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

We propose: EUR 368.75 per unit, payment 90 days net, fixed price, no index clause.

Which cost elements of this part have actually risen since our last price agreement?

We would be glad to finalise on this basis.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
